nerf_raw2outputs: compute rgb, disparity, and depth maps from raw NeRF model predictions along ray samples
nerf_get_ray_dirs: compute transformed ray directions by multiplying camera rotation matrices with input direction vectors
nerf_sample_pdf: perform hierarchical PDF-based sampling from bins and weights for refined NeRF ray marching
LinearlySpacedZNearZFar: generate linearly spaced z-values between z_near and z_far for uniform NeRF ray sampling
FromClassifiedDepth: generate ray sampling z-values from classified depth predictions using PDF-based sampling
